bullets.id: Emas menembus ke bawah $4.000 pada Rabu setelah sempat naik ke $4.066,77 di sesi London. Spot turun 1,2% ke $3.983,55 di sesi New York dan emas berjangka Desember turun sekitar 1% ke $3.991,50, setelah Gubernur Fed Waller menyebut kenaikan 50 bps layak dipertimbangkan dan Presiden Fed Dallas Logan melihat perlunya dua kenaikan 25 bps lagi. Pagi ini emas bertahan di sekitar $3.982, turun 0,14% menurut Trading Economics.
bullets.en: Gold broke below $4,000 on Wednesday after briefly rising to $4,066.77 in London trade. Spot fell 1.2% to $3,983.55 in New York and December futures fell about 1% to $3,991.50, after Fed Governor Waller said a 50 bp hike should be considered and Dallas Fed President Logan saw a need for two more 25 bp hikes. This morning gold holds near $3,982, down 0.14% according to Trading Economics.

bullets.id: Pasar memperkirakan peluang kenaikan bunga Desember sekitar 91% menurut Trading Economics, dengan total tambahan pengetatan hampir 75 bps, dan CME FedWatch memberi peluang 13,2% untuk kenaikan 50 bps. Indeks dolar naik 0,15% ke sekitar 103,0 dan yield 10 tahun di sekitar 4,99%. Emas kini turun sekitar 4,3% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 29% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: Markets put the odds of a December hike near 91% according to Trading Economics, with nearly 75 bp of further tightening priced in total, and CME FedWatch gives a 13.2% chance of a 50 bp hike. The dollar index rose 0.15% to about 103.0 and the 10-year yield sits near 4.99%. Gold is now down about 4.3% on the month and about 29% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Fawad Razaqzada dari FOREX.com menyebut zona $3.942–$4.000 sebagai support kritis, dengan target turun berikutnya di sekitar $3.870 lalu $3.738, sementara resistance di $4.106–$4.140. TD Securities memperkirakan uji ulang $3.900. Malam ini pasar menunggu klaim pengangguran mingguan, lalu PPI pada Jumat 13 November dan keputusan Fed 9 Desember.
bullets.en: FOREX.com’s Fawad Razaqzada sees $3,942–$4,000 as the critical support zone, with the next downside targets near $3,870 and then $3,738, while resistance sits at $4,106–$4,140. TD Securities expects a retest of $3,900. Tonight markets await weekly jobless claims, then PPI on Friday 13 November and the Fed decision on 9 December.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram turun Rp12.000 ke Rp2.518.000 dan buyback turun Rp22.000 ke Rp2.316.000, sehingga spread melebar ke Rp202.000 (sekitar 8,0%). Galeri24 turun Rp22.000 ke Rp2.496.000 (buyback Rp2.349.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS turun Rp22.000 ke Rp2.520.000 (buyback Rp2.324.000, spread sekitar 7,8%). Secara struktural, TD mencatat bank sentral telah membeli 675 ton tahun ini, naik 6% dari periode sama 2025.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price fell Rp12,000 to Rp2,518,000 and buyback fell Rp22,000 to Rp2,316,000, widening the spread to Rp202,000 (about 8.0%). Galeri24 fell Rp22,000 to Rp2,496,000 (buyback Rp2,349,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS fell Rp22,000 to Rp2,520,000 (buyback Rp2,324,000, spread about 7.8%). Structurally, TD notes central banks have bought 675 tonnes this year, up 6% from the same period of 2025.
